thread:
morgan: Spawning a focused follow-up thread: we need owners, short deadlines, and explicit recurrence detection rules for the authz postmortem items. Please state ownership + blocker/date.

ashley: I'll own token validation coverage and the synthetic monitor. Blocker: test SA for nightly run. ETA 2026-04-09.

kevin: I'll own audit ingestion validation + metrics. Plan: strict schema check + authz.audit.dropped_count metric + alert on >0.1% drops over 5m. ETA 2026-04-04.

priya: I'll own secrets rotation automation and emergency playbook. Plan: k8s CronJob + vault rotate + dry-run and rollback script. Need infra approval. ETA 2026-04-21.

ben: I'll update the incident runbook with a "recurrence signals" appendix and oncall checklist. Will add TL;DR and rollback steps. ETA 2026-04-06.

izzy: I'll implement permissions drift detector (compare live IAM vs baseline in git) and surface high-risk diffs as incidents. ETA 2026-04-13.

infra-bot: Ticket created: AUTHZ-1601 (enable 2w detailed audit retention for incident debugging), assigned to infra-team.

morgan: Key recurrence signals to add to runbook: token-parse error spike (>1000/min or 5x baseline), audit gap >30s for a service, sudden rotation failures >3 in 10m. Ben pls codify these thresholds in the checklist.

ashley: For the synthetic monitor I'll exercise issuance, refresh, malformed token, and expired token paths. I'll post job YAML and SA req by EOD.

kevin: Validator sketch I'll add to the ticket: ```python
required=["user_id","token_id","action","ts","svc"]
def valid(e):
    return all(k in e and e[k] for k in required)
```
Will attach test vectors.

priya: Playbook draft snippet: 1) put service in maintenance 2) rotate in dry-run 3) smoke test 15m 4) promote or rollback. Will include notification hooks.

ben: Runbook additions I'll make: detection signals, first-responder checklist, escalation matrix, and a post-change smoke job template.

morgan: Proposed cadence: weekly 30m sync Tues 10:00am PT until all items closed. Owners post progress 24h before sync. If any ETA slips, flag earlier.

ashley: ack. Posting SA request and job YAML later today.

kevin: ack. Linking AUTHZ-1492 and adding PR before next sync.

priya: ack. Coordinating infra access for rotation automation.

izzy: ack. Will add prototype results to AUTHZ-1610.

morgan: Thanks all. I'll create the epics and calendar invite, and pin this thread to the incident ticket.
